limits: Sender counters include warmup, both receiver windows, and post-window controls; they are not restricted to the 20-minute receiver window.
Owned channel bypasses arbitrary callback accounting by construction; zero source overruns alone does not demonstrate absence of host stalls.
Near-full-scale PCM test cannot prove absence of clipping already present in the source.
Different host/network conditions preclude a controlled causal improvement claim.
Twenty-minute completion is not six-hour qualification.
